USAGE:
    fur database backup [database] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [database]    Name of the database to backup. Not required when using --all

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                  Prints help information                         
    -H, --host                  Database host address                           
    -p, --port                  Database port                                   
    -U, --username              Database username                               
    -W, --password              Database password. If not provided, will be     
                                resolved from user config or prompted           
                                interactively                                   
        --ssl-mode              SSL mode. Default: Prefer                       
        --timeout               Connection timeout in seconds. Default: 30      
        --command-timeout       Command timeout in seconds. Default: 300        
    -a, --all                   Backup all databases on the server. Each        
                                database will have its own .dump file           
        --exclude               Exclude tables matching the specified           
                                pattern(s). Can be specified multiple times.    
                                Example: --exclude 'log*'                       
        --exclude-table-data    Exclude table data matching the specified       
                                pattern(s). Can be specified multiple times.    
                                Example: --exclude-table-data 'log*'            
    -v, --verbose               Enable verbose output from pg_dump              
    -o, --output                Output file path (for single database) or folder
                                path (for --all). If not provided, uses current 
                                directory                                       
    -F, --format                Output format: p (plain), c (custom), d         
                                (directory), t (tar). Default: c
